podcast.title: Hybrid Post-Punk Genre
podcast.body: Dance punk was a term for a post-punk genre, interchangeable with others like disco punk and punk funk around 1979-1980. It integrated elements from New Wave, Kraut Rock, funk, rap, Jamaican dub, and disco, often employing disco's "four on the floor" rhythm with slithering bass lines and punk/New Wave instrumentation. "This post-punk genre was known by a number of names. Disco punk, techno punk, dance punk, and punk punk."
